mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_merchant_command(id,command_namespace,actor_type,actor_id,authority_scope,request_id, canonical_version,payload_sha256,canonical_bytes,state,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{id},#{namespace},'USER',#{actor},#{scope},#{requestId},'canonical-v1',#{hash},#{canonical},'RESERVED',UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT id,canonical_version,payload_sha256,canonical_bytes,state,result_version,result_bytes FROM order_merchant_command WHERE command_namespace=#{namespace} AND actor_type='USER' AND actor_id=#{actor} AND authority_scope=#{scope} AND request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE order_merchant_command SET state='SUCCEEDED',result_version=1,result_bytes=#{result},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND state='RESERVED'
mapper.select: SELECT id,order_id,store_id,confirm_round,command_id,action,operator_id,decided_at,event_id, refund_order_id,reason_code,reason_text,internal_note FROM order_merchant_decision WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND confirm_round=0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_order SET order_stage=#{stage},confirm_mode=#{mode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},confirmed_at=#{confirmedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, canceled_at=#{canceledAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},cancel_reason=#{cancelReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, refund_order_id=#{refundId,jdbcType=BIGINT},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{orderId} AND version=#{version} AND order_stage='PENDING_CONFIRM' AND payment_status='PAID' AND verification_status='UNVERIFIED' AND reschedule_count=0 AND confirm_deadline > #{now} AND confirm_mode IS NULL AND confirmed_at IS NULL AND canceled_at IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL AND refund_order_id IS NULL AND current_refund_application_id IS NULL AND current_aftersale_id IS NULL AND refunded_amount=0

UPDATE pet_order SET refunded_amount=#{amount},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND refund_order_id=#{refundId} AND order_stage='CANCELED' AND cancel_reason='MERCHANT_REJECT_ORDER' AND refunded_amount=0
